title: A quiet day in the Book
note: The Book shows one small row, "A quiet day", with the date: muted, unsigned, not a card and not a button into a letter. It is never counted, printed or read in Read together, and it hides on any day that has a letter.
text: For Asha Asha's book Read together Month 7 Thursday, October 15, 2026 A quiet day Month 6 2 letters · From Mama Sunday, October 11, 2026 Bath time. You splash with your whole body, both hands, both feet, and then you check that I saw. From Mama Tuesday, September 22, 2026 You rolled over all by yourself, twice, and then looked at me like you had always known how. From Mama Private 0:42 Month 5 1 letter · From Mama From Mama 0:42 Month 3 1 letter · From Mama Friday, July 3, 2026 You smell like warm milk and the lavender soap Papa insists on. I could sit here all night. From Mama Month 2 1 letter · From Mama Monday, May 18, 2026 You laughed today. A real one. It sounded like a little hiccup that surprised you as much as it surprised me. lines: Bath time. You splash with your whole body, both hands, both feet, and then you check that I saw.
You rolled over all by yourself, twice, and then looked at me like you had always known how.
You smell like warm milk and the lavender soap Papa insists on. I could sit here all night.
You laughed today. A real one. It sounded like a little hiccup that surprised you as much as it surprised me.
Asha, you are four days old and the whole house is quiet. Your Nani made dal and nobody ate it because we were all watching you sleep.
